note: Programs looked at and not given a page, with the reason; and rows suggested for the comparison but not taken in (each would need Schnellbild's and every program's value with a source).

dropped.name: Phiewer Select
dropped.why: separate $4.99 culling app by the Phiewer developer; not a viewer alternative (could be added later)

dropped.name: Camera RawX
dropped.why: Quick Look extension companion of ApolloOne, not a viewer

dropped.name: PhotoMill X (now 'PhotoMill: The Image Converter', Mac App Store, $14.99, v3.5.1)
dropped.why: Batch converter/metadata editor; its browser only picks files for conversion. No full-screen viewer, slideshow or video playback in the store description (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id778590574).

dropped.name: ViewIt (HexCat)
dropped.why: The real product is HexCat ViewIt, shareware image viewer/browser. Last version 2.66 from 2017-12-18, 'Mac OS X 10.6 or later (Intel only)' per Softpedia (https://mac.softpedia.com/get/Graphics/ViewIt.shtml); hexcat.com no longer serves the product page (TLS certificate belongs to an unrelated host). Dead, no Apple silicon build, little search demand; matrix would be mostly inferred.

dropped.name: Vidu
dropped.why: Vidu is an AI video generation service (Shengshu Technology / Tsinghua), not a Mac image or media viewer; only an unofficial WebCatalog web wrapper exists for Mac (https://webcatalog.io/apps/vidu).

dropped.name: Vidi: Universal 4K Player
dropped.why: Similar name found while checking Vidu; it is a video-only player, outside this image-viewer group.

dropped.name: zGallery - Image Viewer
dropped.why: Maintained MAS viewer ($9.99, 4.86, July 2026; https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id702923456) with folder tree, tabs, file copy/move and video in slideshow, but the store page is too thin to fill the matrix without mostly inferred cells; candidate for a later hands-on pass.

dropped.name: ToyViewer
dropped.why: Free MAS viewer by Takeshi Ogihara, last update 5.8.0 on 2022-02-12, listed as discontinued with the website gone; no longer available in some storefronts.

dropped.name: Fileloupe
dropped.why: Interesting media browser (images, video, PDF), but last version 1.7.3 dated 2019-09-04 on the MAS (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fileloupe-media-browser/id944693506); effectively unmaintained.

dropped.name: ImageViewer: Video Player and Photo Image Viewer
dropped.why: Archive-aware image/video viewer on the MAS, but last update 1.71 in 2016 (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id771344738); dead.

dropped.name: ViewPic
dropped.why: MAS $4.99, last update 1.2.0 in 2015 (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/viewpic/id899361067); dead.

dropped.name: FastViewer (Pleeq)
dropped.why: Small direct-download viewer (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF only; https://pleeq.com/macos-apps/fastviewer/), no price/version stated, no visible user base.

dropped.name: Viso
dropped.why: Minimal paid viewer (Viso 6, 2023 Product Hunt launch); conflicting price info and no official page read; low overlap (single-image window).

dropped.name: Vimple
dropped.why: HDR/EDR full-screen carousel viewer ($5.99, macOS 15); niche, too little overlap.

dropped.name: Kuvat / Vimage / Imagine / PictureView
dropped.why: No Mac image viewer by these names found in search; 'Imagine' is a Windows-only viewer.

dropped.name: ACDSee 中国版 (ACDSee 图影工坊 / ACDSee 官方免费版, acdsee.cn)
dropped.why: Same products as the global ACDSee Photo Studio, ACDSee Photo Studio for Mac and ACDSee Free, sold in China under Chinese names by the distributor 上海昂毅多媒体科技 with CNY prices (e.g. Home ¥298 lifetime or ¥198/year, Mac 26 ¥368/¥798 lifetime as listed 2026-11-14 on https://www.acdsee.cn/). Fold into the global ACDSee entry; Chinese search terms: "ACDSee 图影工坊", "ACDSee mac 中文版", "ACDSee 官方免费版".

dropped.name: 光影看图 (Xunlei / Neo Imaging)
dropped.why: Companion viewer offered by the 光影魔术手 installer (v4.6.4.923 per https://sj.qq.com/appdetail/com.tencent.pcgame.xunguangyingkantu); its own site kantu.xunlei.com doesn't resolve and no feature docs could be found, so a matrix would be mostly guesses

dropped.name: WPS图片 (WPS Photos)
dropped.why: Desktop viewer last listed as 6.0.0.1 from 2022 (https://sj.qq.com/appdetail/com.tencent.pcgame.wpswpstupian); photo.wps.cn is now an online editor. Too little current documentation

dropped.name: 360看图
dropped.why: No reachable official product page (360 baoku page 404); only third-party download sites

dropped.name: 爱奇艺看图
dropped.why: Only seen as a listing on https://sj.qq.com/software/310010; not researched for lack of time and evidence

dropped.name: Linar
dropped.why: image filer from 1999 (Madonna no Mori review 1999-02-15); no current site or download found, not searched any more

dropped.name: Susie
dropped.why: plug-in host/viewer from the 1990s; covered as plug-in ecosystem inside MassiGra, Hamana, Leeyes, NeeView rows

dropped.name: MangaMeeyaCE
dropped.why: compact fork of MangaMeeya, merged into the MangaMeeya entry

dropped.name: Windows Photo Viewer (classic)
dropped.why: Part of Windows 7, hidden in Windows 10/11, no product of its own; kept as search terms under Microsoft Photos

dropped.name: Photos Legacy
dropped.why: Covered as a note under Microsoft Photos (same vendor, older app with video editor)

dropped.name: Plex (desktop / HTPC for Mac)
dropped.why: Not a local file player: the Mac/desktop app plays libraries from a Plex Media Server; serverless local-file playback exists only on Android. Evidence: https://techcrunch.com/2017/06/14/plex-can-now-play-local-video-files-on-android-no-media-server-required/ , https://forums.plex.tv/t/add-prefer-downloaded-content-for-macos-mod-plex-desktop-apps/875131

dropped.name: NetPlayer (App Store id6755069320)
dropped.why: An XUI/IPTV client for iPhone/iPad (Spanish-only listing), no Mac app and no local file playback: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/netplayer/id6755069320 . nPlayer (Newin) was added instead in case that was meant.

dropped.name: SenPlayer
dropped.why: Library/NAS player of the same kind as VidHub with fewer ratings (173 US); left out to avoid a near-duplicate page

dropped.name: Downie
dropped.why: Downloader, not a player (per brief)

dropped.name: KMPlayer for Mac
dropped.why: Vendor FAQ: 'A dedicated KMPlayer desktop application for macOS is not currently available'; folded into the KMPlayer entry (mac_available no).

dropped.name: GOM Player for iOS/iPad on Mac
dropped.why: iPad app listed as 'Designed for iPad. Not verified for macOS'; not a Mac player, mentioned in the GOM entry.

dropped.name: Windows Media Player Legacy (separate entry)
dropped.why: Merged into the Windows Media Player entry with notes, as instructed.

dropped.name: Chunky Comic Reader
dropped.why: iPad-only app (App Store lists only iPad devices), last update 2.5.10 on 2020-08-16, no Mac build; https://apps.apple.com/app/id663567628

dropped.name: ComicBookLover (Bitcartel)
dropped.why: Mac app discontinued, no longer on app stores, vendor download unavailable (AlternativeTo); little current search interest; https://alternativeto.net/software/comicbooklover/about/

dropped.name: Total Commander for Android
dropped.why: Covered as a note under Total Commander; no Mac relevance

dropped.name: Norton Commander for Windows
dropped.why: Merged into the Norton Commander entry (same brand, also discontinued)

dropped.name: Photo Mechanic Plus (separate product)
dropped.why: Treated as a tier inside Photo Mechanic; Camera Bits stopped selling it on 27 Feb 2026 (catalog feature broken on current macOS)

dropped.name: Murasaki
dropped.why: Maintained (Mac App Store 2.5.1, 2024-11-07, ¥1,300), but it is an EPUB text reader by Genji App: no CBZ/CBR, archives or image folders, so no real overlap with Schnellbild. https://genjiapp.com/mac/murasaki/index_en.html, https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=430300762&country=jp
